subject: luna-meadows
q: CLOSED — LUNA IS ETHEREAL. Ruled in four words, and her measurements agreed without being asked to.
detail:
THE INFERENCE IS STRONG AND IT IS STILL AN INFERENCE, AND THIS ARCHIVE HAS A SPECIFIC REASON TO DISTRUST ITS OWN STRONG INFERENCES ABOUT LUNA. It once decided her parasol had been out there SEVENTEEN YEARS, built arithmetic on top of the invention — ONE THOUSAND THREE HUNDRED AND TWENTY-SIX ATTEMPTS — and then put the number in a raccoon’s mouth. THE REAL FIGURE IS ELEVEN. Arc 2.

SO: Viraena named Luna’s legs as the EXAMPLE of what Build-derived Framing means, then named Ethereal as the leggy Build. The example was chosen to illustrate the mechanism, which is not quite the same act as assigning the Build — Huntress also leans leg, and a woman can have legs for days on a Build that merely leans.

WHAT WOULD SETTLE IT: Luna’s Primary Build, stated. One word. AND THE ARCHIVE IS NOT WRITING ETHEREAL INTO HER RECORD UNTIL IT HEARS IT, because the cost of being right early is zero and the cost of being wrong in ink is a correction with her name on it.
